A second site, in its own repository, indexing the writing that has accumulated
in Google Docs and does not belong on TrinityMetrics: the doc on meaning, the
pathways tools, the parenting material, the ukulele and Hamilton song maps. The
Documents stay unshared and the site organizes them for their author, publishing
only the few that are meant to be read by anyone. Nothing is built yet. This
folder holds the scope.

## Documents

- [Working specification](specification.qmd). What the site holds, the two
  switches that decide what is exposed, the inventory of sources to fill in, and
  the checks the first build has to pass.
